message.jaymospowers.station.inscription: Lay a piece of gear and a gem on the table, then carve it with a chisel.
The inscription table takes gear that can be enchanted, a gem, and a chisel to carve with.
message.jaymospowers.station.blast_furna: The blast furnace isn't built: a firebrick tower 3 wide, 3 deep and 4 high, hollow from the second layer up, with this mouth in the middle of a side.
Load it with iron ingots and coal coke. Nothing is ready to take yet.
message.jaymospowers.station.coke_oven.u: The coke oven isn't built: a 3x3x3 of coke oven bricks round a hollow middle, with this mouth in one wall.
message.jaymospowers.station.coke_oven.t: Load it with coal or logs. Nothing is baked yet.
message.jaymospowers.station.casting.tab: Set a cast on the table, then pour metal over it from a faucet.
message.jaymospowers.station.casting.bas: Pour metal in from a faucet to cast a block.
message.jaymospowers.station.smithing_an: Lay a hot ingot or a forging blank on the anvil, then strike it with a smithing hammer.
message.jaymospowers.station.forge_heart: The hearth needs coal or charcoal, then a light from flint and steel.
The hearth has fuel but isn't lit: use flint and steel or a fire charge.
Put metal in the coals to heat it, and take it out with tongs.
The hearth can't take more fuel.
message.jaymospowers.station.chopping_bl: Stand logs on the chopping block, then chop them with an axe.
